g.text: Component view · Processing separates control from execution
Amber = Processing (including media_engine); slate = shared library. Circle = provided exports; dashed = dependency.
Direct ORM persists state. Stores adapt Minio; Supervisor adapts subprocess; engine functions are pure builders.
handlers wraps SQS with processing.launcher_trigger.WakeOnWork; EcsPort/QueueDepth adapt boto3 ECS/SQS.
